merges.canonical_name: Asha requests time to verify the documents
aliases: Asha asserts control over the sale decision
merges.justification: All three describe the same exchange in scene 1: Asha refuses to accept the offer that day and asks for a few days to confirm whether a later instrument/codicil exists. The evidence samples overlap directly in wording and narrative function.

merges.canonical_name: Asha reflects on father's portfolio and Daniel's denial
merges.justification: These are the same interior reflection in scene 1. Each mentions Asha thinking about her father's portfolio and Daniel's absolute denial that there was a later instrument; the descriptions differ only by emphasis on different parts of the same thought sequence.
Both refer to the same memory of a supervisor's evaluation note about confusing compassion with neutrality, with no narrative distinction beyond paraphrase.

unmerged.name: requests to attend search
unmerged.justification: This is a separate action by Daniel asking to be present for any search of the house; it is not the same event as Asha's refusal/request for time or her later reflections.

unmerged.name: reflect on financial pressure
unmerged.justification: This is a distinct post-call reflection about the buyer's agent, tax bill, and bridge loan pressure. It occurs in the same scene but has different content and narrative function from the other reflection events.
